text:
kayla (product): Quick proposal — add a "soft cap" feature in Console + API so customers can self-serve temporary increases to their dedicated burst limits. Safety model: time-limited, scoped to tenant, auto-rolls back, and optional billing holdouts. Who volunteers to spec the backend policy and rollout criteria?
raf (eng): Quick q — how is this different from existing burst credits/allowed spillover?
kayla (product): Good call. Difference is: 1) self-serve in Console (no SE handoff), 2) small time-limited increases (hours -> days) with automatic revert, 3) hard limits enforced by policy service (not just soft quotas), 4) explicit billing/charge flags so finance can opt-in for immediate charges or invoice later.
mina (eng-sre): Danger modes: tenants could spike and blow regional pools. Need throttles + admission controls. Also need signal to oncall if aggregate region alloc > X%.
liz (solutions): From CS perspective, we need an audit trail and easy rollback button. Also a message template for customers: "how to request extension".
tom (finance): We need clear tags for whether usage is billable immediately or accrues to reserved commitment. Also exportable CSV for reconciliation. If self-serve leads to charge, require acceptance checkbox in Console.
raf (eng): Sketching a minimal API + DB flag. Example (pseudo):
```
POST /v1/tenants/:id/soft-cap
body: {"amount_tokens": 1000000, "duration_minutes": 240, "billing_behavior": "charge_now|invoice"}
response: {"id":"sc_12345", "status":"active", "expires_at":"2026-04-01T15:23:00Z"}
```
Enforcement: policy-service checks active soft-caps before admitting to reserved pool admission.
mina (eng-sre): Need rate-limits on API (per-tenant) and global gating. Canary idea: enable self-serve for 5 pilot tenants in NA first, region cap at 10% of pool capacity, alert if >80% of that cap.
kayla (product): Rollout gating checklist (short):
• Spec merged + API contract approved by eng
• Policy-service integration + tests
• Console flow + consent checkbox + audit log
• Billing tag + CSV export ready (finance signoff)
• 5 pilot tenants onboarded + 1-week canary metrics pass
• Ops runbook + rollback button in Console
• Docs + CS templates published
mina (eng-sre): For metrics, we want: admitted_soft_cap_tokens, soft_cap_requests, soft_cap_reverts, region_soft_cap_usage_pct, oncall_alerts_triggered. Hook to existing dashboards.
raf (eng): Implementation tasks (estimates):
• API & DB model (1wk)
• Policy-service check + tests (1.5wk)
• Console UX + consent flow (1wk)
• Billing export + flags (finance collab) (0.5wk)
• E2E canary + telemetry (1wk)
Total ~5-6w including QA. Can parallelize.
tom (finance): If we do "charge_now" option, require a billing opt-in toggle per tenant account. Also add a daily export with soft-cap line items.
liz (solutions): I'll draft CS templates and a short risk-warning modal copy for Console. Can pick pilot tenants (we have 3 customers asking already).
kayla (product): Owner proposals: raf -> implement API & policy; mina -> canary gating & dashboards; liz -> CS + docs; tom -> billing export + flag. Anyone object?
raf (eng): ack, taking API/policy.
mina (eng-sre): ack, will wire alerts and canary thresholds.
 liz (solutions): ack, will draft templates and customer comms.
tom (finance): ack, will spec export and consent requirement.
deploy-bot: FYI — migration script for soft_cap table must run in maintenance window. Schedule after canary sign-off.
kayla (product): Thanks all — I'll open the spec PR with the checklist and link pilot customer list. Next sync: standup tomorrow to assign Jira tickets. :thumbsup:
